campaign.title: Ottawa Times · October 2022 election recap
campaign.note: Dated October 25, updated October 26, 2022. Records at least three new suburban dog parks. Original archived platform not obtained; no precise deadline in this source.

morgan_open.title: Kanata North councillor · August 10, 2026 opening report
morgan_open.note: Reports Sunday’s ceremony: August 9, 2026, derived from publication date and weekday. This is a ceremony date, not a verified first day of public use.

morgan_plan.title: City · Morgan’s Grant consultation
morgan_plan.note: 2023 consultation; construction then anticipated in 2024. A forecast, not an opening.

morgan_grass.title: Kanata North councillor · June 27, 2025 update
morgan_grass.note: Constructed site awaiting grass establishment; possible opening the next spring. Not proof of a 2025 opening.

casey_plan.title: Barrhaven councillor · McKenna Casey project
casey_plan.note: Construction began July 2025, completion listed as 2026; identifies same site formerly consulted on as Gregory Casey.

casey_use.title: Mayor · McKenna Casey public-use report
casey_use.note: Public post says residents already use the new park. Interested-party report; only relative post age displayed. Observed October 24, 2026, not an exact opening or publication date.

shea.title: Stittsville councillor · February 27, 2026 Shea Woods update
shea.note: Acquisition complete; informal use predates 2022. Park design/engagement still to come. January wording called it a permanent dog park; February clarifies future development.

andy.title: Andy Shields · substantial-performance certificate
andy.note: City-owned construction contract substantially performed November 12, 2024; certificate signed December 4, 2024 (US-style dates on page). No public-opening date established.

andy_location.title: City · Andy Shields project
andy_location.note: 1448 Meadow Drive, Ward 20, Greely. Kept as a rural-village project, outside strict suburban comparison.

richmond.title: City · Richmond dog-park update, October 1, 2026
richmond.note: Site work began late September; not open while grass establishes. Opening timing depends on fall 2026/spring 2027 weather; no firm opening date.

reported_four.title: CBC via Yahoo · August 20, 2026 promise review
reported_four.note: Reports four citywide openings but does not name them in the reviewed text. Not substituted for a verified list of suburban openings.

location.title: Map locations and geometry provenance
location.note: City park geometry, OpenStreetMap/Mapcarta reference points and an Esri address geocode. Approximate site markers, not entrances; methods and source URLs in the map export.

parks.name: Morgan’s Grant Hydro Corridor
parks.note: New fenced park. First public-use date is not established.

Opening ceremony reported the following day.

parks.name: McKenna Casey
parks.note: Mayor reports people using the new park; exact opening date unverified. Gregory Casey and McKenna Casey refer to this same project.

history.text: Mayor reports residents already using the new park; exact post date unavailable.

parks.name: Shea Woods
parks.note: Longstanding informal dog-walking area. Acquisition is complete; planned amenities and engagement are not a verified new opening.

history.text: Council acquisition agreement approved; informal use already existed.
City ownership confirmed; future park plans still to be finalized.

parks.name: Andy Shields
parks.note: Certificate verifies construction, not public access. Rural-village location is kept outside the suburban comparison.

history.text: Contract substantially performed; certificate signed December 4.

parks.name: Richmond Dog Park
parks.note: Grass must establish before opening. Rural-village location; excluded from suburban count.

history.text: City says stay out until further notice; no firm opening date.

method: Selected project evidence since November 15, 2022, not an exhaustive inventory. One documented suburban ceremony and one separate mayor-reported suburban public-use site. These evidence categories are distinct. Acquisition, informal use, construction completion and rural-village projects are not silently counted as new suburban openings. No pass/fail or completion percentage.
